properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.enabled
properties.description: Enable the bounded local filesystem remote-log provider.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.root
properties.description: Managed log root. Required when the local provider is enabled.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.module
properties.description: Module identity exposed in remote-log metadata.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.service
properties.description: Service identity exposed in remote-log metadata.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.instance
properties.description: Instance identity exposed in remote-log metadata.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.retention
properties.description: Retention window used to decide whether an artifact is downloadable.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.active-window
properties.description: Recent uncompressed files inside this window are treated as active.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.bundle-ttl
properties.description: Lifetime of generated local bundle artifacts.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-scanned-files
properties.description: Maximum path entries inspected by one operation.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-search-bytes
properties.description: Maximum decoded bytes inspected for content identifier search.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-preview-bytes
properties.description: Maximum source bytes used for a preview.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-preview-decoded-characters
properties.description: Maximum decoded characters consumed by compressed preview.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-raw-line-characters
properties.description: Maximum raw characters retained from one source line before masking.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-download-bytes
properties.description: Maximum size of a downloadable artifact.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-bundle-bytes
properties.description: Maximum total source size included in one bundle.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.maximum-bundle-artifacts
properties.description: Maximum distinct artifact IDs accepted by one bundle request.

properties.name: cpf.remote-log.local.source-already-masked
properties.description: Allows direct source-file download only when the producer guarantees that every persisted line is already masked. Preview and bundle outputs are sanitized regardless.
